overview_description.description: Walzay is a staffing and recruiting platform that connects companies with vetted global talent, particularly in technology, AI, finance, and leadership roles. The company operates as a hybrid recruitment marketplace and executive search firm, helping businesses source full-time, remote, and leadership professionals across multiple countries. Walzay also provides hiring management tools, candidate matching, and recruitment support for employers and job seekers worldwide.
